_meta.purpose: M098-minimum definition and unit for indicators that reached the catalog without them. Derived from the label, measured coverage and source citation already on the indicator; nothing here is invented.
_meta.doctrine: apply_curation_16 fills a field ONLY when it is empty, so curated prose always wins and regenerating this cannot flatten it. An indicator promoted to the featured tier should have its definition hand-written in 04_indicator_definitions.json, which is applied first.
